en.NAME: IT Resources
en.DESCRIPTION: Workflow for monitored IT resources. States align with Resource diagnostic status values and include one root state for resources that have not been provisioned yet.

en.NAME: Active
en.DESCRIPTION: Resource is enabled, expected to exist, and participates in normal operations.

en.NAME: Disable
en.DESCRIPTION: Administratively disable this resource so automation and alert escalation do not treat it as active.

en.NAME: Retire
en.DESCRIPTION: Retire this active resource while preserving history.

en.NAME: Critical
en.DESCRIPTION: Latest diagnostic evaluation found a critical condition requiring prompt attention.

en.NAME: Critical to Down
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Critical to Down.

en.NAME: Critical to Fail By Dependency
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Critical to Fail By Dependency.

en.NAME: Critical to N/A
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Critical to N/A.

en.NAME: Critical to Pass
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Critical to Pass.

en.NAME: Critical to Degraded
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Critical to Degraded.

en.NAME: Disabled
en.DESCRIPTION: Resource is administratively disabled and should not participate in automation or alert escalation.

en.NAME: Activate
en.DESCRIPTION: Return this resource to active operation and monitoring.

en.NAME: Retire Disabled
en.DESCRIPTION: Retire this disabled resource while preserving history.

en.NAME: Down
en.DESCRIPTION: Latest diagnostic evaluation failed. The resource is considered unavailable or non-operational.

en.NAME: Down to Critical
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Down to Critical.

en.NAME: Down to Fail By Dependency
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Down to Fail By Dependency.

en.NAME: Down to N/A
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Down to N/A.

en.NAME: Down to Pass
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Down to Pass.

en.NAME: Down to Degraded
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Down to Degraded.

en.NAME: Fail By Dependency
en.DESCRIPTION: The resource cannot be evaluated or operated because a required dependency is unavailable.

en.NAME: Fail By Dependency to Critical
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Fail By Dependency to Critical.

en.NAME: Fail By Dependency to Down
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Fail By Dependency to Down.

en.NAME: Fail By Dependency to N/A
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Fail By Dependency to N/A.

en.NAME: Fail By Dependency to Pass
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Fail By Dependency to Pass.

en.NAME: Fail By Dependency to Degraded
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Fail By Dependency to Degraded.

en.NAME: N/A
en.DESCRIPTION: Diagnostic evaluation is not applicable or not currently available for this resource.

en.NAME: N/A to Critical
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from N/A to Critical.

en.NAME: N/A to Down
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from N/A to Down.

en.NAME: N/A to Fail By Dependency
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from N/A to Fail By Dependency.

en.NAME: N/A to Pass
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from N/A to Pass.

en.NAME: N/A to Degraded
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from N/A to Degraded.

en.NAME: Not Provisioned
en.DESCRIPTION: Resource has been defined but has not yet been provisioned into active monitoring dimensions. This is the single workflow root state and has no incoming events.

en.NAME: Provision
en.DESCRIPTION: Provision this resource into active monitoring with lifecycle Active, diagnostic N/A, and maintenance Operational states.

en.NAME: Operational
en.DESCRIPTION: No maintenance condition is currently open for this resource. Diagnostic health is represented by the diagnostic state.

en.NAME: Require Maintenance
en.DESCRIPTION: Mark that this resource requires maintenance or support attention.

en.NAME: Start Maintenance Directly
en.DESCRIPTION: Start maintenance for this resource without first marking it as requiring maintenance.

en.NAME: Pass
en.DESCRIPTION: Latest diagnostic evaluation passed. All monitored checks are within acceptable bounds.

en.NAME: Pass to Critical
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Pass to Critical.

en.NAME: Pass to Down
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Pass to Down.

en.NAME: Pass to Fail By Dependency
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Pass to Fail By Dependency.

en.NAME: Pass to N/A
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Pass to N/A.

en.NAME: Pass to Degraded
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Pass to Degraded.

en.NAME: Requires Maintenance
en.DESCRIPTION: The resource requires maintenance or support attention, but work has not started yet.

en.NAME: Start Maintenance
en.DESCRIPTION: Mark that maintenance work has started for this resource.

en.NAME: Clear Maintenance Requirement
en.DESCRIPTION: Clear the maintenance requirement without starting maintenance work.

en.NAME: Retired
en.DESCRIPTION: Resource is retained for history but is no longer expected to be monitored or operated.

en.NAME: Under Maintenance
en.DESCRIPTION: Maintenance work is in progress. Diagnostic failures may be expected and should be handled differently from operational failures.

en.NAME: Complete Maintenance
en.DESCRIPTION: Close the active maintenance condition and return this resource to operational maintenance state.

en.NAME: Degraded
en.DESCRIPTION: Latest diagnostic evaluation found a warning condition. The resource is degraded and should be reviewed.

en.NAME: Degraded to Critical
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Degraded to Critical.

en.NAME: Degraded to Down
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Degraded to Down.

en.NAME: Degraded to Fail By Dependency
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Degraded to Fail By Dependency.

en.NAME: Degraded to N/A
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Degraded to N/A.

en.NAME: Degraded to Pass
en.DESCRIPTION: Move diagnostic state from Degraded to Pass.
